title: TicketQRSchema
description: Schema for extracting Metro QR Ticket screen fields

ticket_id.description: Unique metro ticket identifier, e.g. TKT-892104

order_id.description: Booking or order ID from the chatbot/app

origin_station.description: Source metro station, e.g. Indiranagar, MG Road

timestamp.description: Booking date and time or validity timestamp

payee_name.description: Metro agency name, e.g. BMRCL or Namma Metro

app_name.description: Channel app: WhatsApp, Namma Metro App, Paytm, etc.

language_detected.description: Language of text, e.g. en, kn, hi
